> **⚠️ PLATFORM POLICY — READ BEFORE FILING**
>
> This project **does not support Windows and will not accept Windows-related
> feature requests or porting requests**. We have no plan to make any
> Windows-specific improvements, now or in the future.
>
> Please use **Linux** or **macOS** as your development platform.
> Requests filed from a Windows environment will be closed as `wontfix`
> without further discussion.

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear description of the problem or limitation you are facing.
e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]"

**Proposed solution**
What you want to happen.

**Environment**

| Item | Detail |
|---|---|
| OS | e.g. Ubuntu 24.04 LTS / macOS 15.3 (Sequoia) |
| Agent used | e.g. milletcode agent, smartcode, ... |
| Remote access? | Yes / No — if yes, how (operator, gateway, SSH tunnel, ...) |

**Alternatives considered**
Any workarounds or alternative approaches you have tried or considered.

**Additional context**
Screenshots, links, or other context.
